svg.title: CoreCV Blog Agent Full Architecture
svg.desc: Full architecture diagram showing the CoreCV AI blog agent pipeline from cron triggers through topic picking, blog generation, human review via email, and publishing.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Thursday cron job work?')
sendPrompt('How does the topic picker agent work?')

sendPrompt('What happens to topic status after review?')

sendPrompt('What is in the CoreCV knowledge base?')

sendPrompt('How does the Tavily search tool help the writer?')
sendPrompt('What does the reviewer agent check?')

sendPrompt('What does the blog email review look like?')
sendPrompt('How does Railway handle the blog approval webhook?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a blog is approved?')
sendPrompt('How does the publishing cron job work?')
sendPrompt('How does the publisher pick the next blog?')
sendPrompt('How does the blog get posted to the CoreCV website?')
